svg.aria-label: Queen 2.3 and 2.4 at 3 million messages a second on one queue of 10 to 10 million partitions: end to end latency, CPU, leader memory, disk writes and disk time a write
svg.text: Queen 2.3 and 2.4 at 3M msg/s: one queue, 10 to 10M partitions
Three GCP c4-standard-24-lssd brokers (24 vCPU, 88 GB, four local NVMe disks in RAID0) and three 16-vCPU loaders
end to end latency = pushed until consumed
partitions in one queue (each step is 10 times the one before)

svg.text: 2.4 = 2.3.0 plus three changes that cut the bytes written a message (not released). 2.3 measured on 2026-10-14, 2.4 on 2026-10-15.
A fresh three-node cluster for each point; 100 messages of 256 B a request (binary push, zstd), counted acks, framed pops; dedup off, nothing deleted.
Latency: the slowest of nine load processes, the median of its three 10 s windows in seconds 30-60 (the docs' figure). Disk: /dev/md0, seconds 30-60.
1,000 partitions: five runs of each version, the median drawn (p99 of 2.4's runs 15, 17, 18, 20, 65 ms; of 2.3's 44, 46, 47, 50, 61 ms).
10M partitions ran with QUEEN_CONSUME_IDLE_UNLOAD_S=30. 2.3 at 100k: one pop of millions timed out (HTTP 503).
